verdict.rationale: Paxos docs explicitly document accepting PYUSD/USDC/USDP payments with an option to 'Automatically convert the stablecoin to fiat, or opt to hold balances in stablecoin' and 'Settle USD directly to your bank account,' directly matching the finance-lead's need to never hold crypto on the books. This is reinforced by dedicated redeem/mint orchestration APIs converting stablecoins to USD and withdrawing to bank in one call. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation beyond vendor docs, and no explicit statement of default behavior or accounting/reporting implications for books.
